selection.weak_bfs: weak directed-neighbor BFS, each neighbor list rank-ordered; rank-ordered unvisited roots refill disconnected components; retain first N dequeued nodes then sort original IDs
selection.ranked: N smallest rank keys without looking at edges; sparse/disconnected outcomes are retained
selection.boundary: every crossing directed pair of the qualified induced source is saved with original u64 endpoints, measured contacts and incoming/outgoing category; raw unknown-endpoint boundary remains distinct

controls.edge_count: Floyd sampling of exactly E non-self directed pairs
controls.degree: bounded directed double-edge switches with four distinct endpoints; preserve each vertex in/out degree
controls.degree_reciprocal: also preserve each vertex reciprocal-neighbor count
controls.degree_reciprocal_block: also preserve the complete directed block-pair edge-count matrix
controls.attempt_budget: min(32 * E, 1000000) proposals per rewired arm
controls.blocks: frozen source metadata region labels, whitespace trimmed, null/empty explicit; anatomical blocks, not inferred functional communities or preserved modularity
controls.weights: unit edge in every comparison arm, including reference; original measured multiplicities saved separately, not reassigned as conductance
limitations: no guarantee of uniform switch-chain sampling
connectivity and higher motifs are not preserved
unchanged and edge-empty controls must remain visible

ports: same three distinct indices for every arm, selected by sorted SplitMix64(root_id XOR seed XOR 0x1234abcd); no performance-dependent placement or training
acceptance: Source graph, previous qualification and metadata hashes match before and after use.
Rust synthetic tests and independent Python/process tests pass before real data.
Independent reader verifies exact induced pairs, measured weights and every crossing edge.
Every declared degree, reciprocity and block invariant agrees with an independent recount.
Every case replays with identical output file hashes.
Port disconnection, no-change controls, sampling bias and unavailable mixing evidence remain explicit.
